title: Stepper
summary: A wizard header: numbered steps with done, current, upcoming and error states, horizontal or vertical, optionally clickable (linear: you can go back, not skip ahead).

props.name: clickable
props.description: Steps can be entered by click or key.

props.name: free
props.description: Allow skipping ahead of the furthest step reached (non-linear).

props.name: errors
props.description: Comma-separated step indexes with an error.

a11y: A labelled list; each step announces "Step 2 of 4: Pricing, current"; the current step has aria-current="step"; clickable steps are buttons reachable by Tab and by arrow keys.
mobile: Horizontal steppers show only the current step’s title next to the markers; clickable steps are 44px tall.

examples.title: Horizontal stepper (clickable, linear)
examples.html: <pk-stepper label="Create product" current="1" clickable><pk-step title="Basics" description="Name and type"></pk-step><pk-step title="Pricing" description="Cost and price"></pk-step><pk-step title="Images"></pk-step><pk-step title="Review"></pk-step></pk-stepper>

examples.title: Vertical stepper with an error
examples.html: <pk-stepper label="Import" current="2" orientation="vertical" errors="0"><pk-step title="Upload" description="File rejected"></pk-step><pk-step title="Map columns"></pk-step><pk-step title="Review"></pk-step><pk-step title="Finish"></pk-step></pk-stepper>
